messages: It seems the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000# is finally ready to acknowledge my leatherworking skills.
Impressed by my growth, the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000# suggested that I showcase what I'm capable of. I need to defeat #r#o22#s#k and craft #b1 #t3010005##k, then bring it back.

Amazed by my craftsmanship, the leatherworking master #p401# of #m10003000# handed me a #t4130002#. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter equipment stats. Should I try using it?
name: A Leatherworker in My Own Right!
